subject.title: [Bug]: Discord sends failed during a full network outage are dropped on reconnect (send_attempt_started refuses replay, no reconcileUnknownSend)

question: Which open repair path should be treated as the canonical fix for this issue before it closes?
rationale: The linked PRs change different safety boundaries, and the durable delivery contract requires proof that any replay path will not duplicate messages after a true unknown platform send.

options.title: Prefer connect-phase recovery repair
options.body: Review the core repair that clears recovery state only for errors proven pre-dispatch, because it matches the observed full-outage failure without replaying every Discord unknown send.

options.title: Require idempotent Discord reconciliation
options.body: Accept a Discord adapter repair only if it uses Discord message identity or nonce enforcement to distinguish sent from not-sent instead of returning `not_sent` unconditionally.

options.title: Stage both fixes
options.body: Land the connect-phase recovery fix first for the reported outage, then track idempotent Discord reconciliation as the crash-recovery follow-up.

recommendation.title: Prefer connect-phase recovery repair
recommendation.body: Review the core repair that clears recovery state only for errors proven pre-dispatch, because it matches the observed full-outage failure without replaying every Discord unknown send.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to durable lifecycle and documentation ownership across the shared recovery contract.
